independence_evidence: Published by Adbusters Media Foundation, described on its own shop terms and privacy pages as a not-for-profit organisation based in Vancouver, BC; the about page says every dollar raised goes back into the magazine and campaigns; no corporate owner.
qualifies_reason: Long-running not-for-profit bimonthly from Vancouver with #187 out (late September 2026 per the publisher's schedule) and #188 due late November 2026.
what_it_is: Adbusters is a bimonthly anti-consumerist 'journal of the mental environment' from Vancouver, mixing political and philosophical essays, spoof advertisements, collage and hand-lettered design into a largely ad-free, image-led magazine. Issue #187 is themed around a 'post-liberal imagination' and a rejection of AI-driven culture. It is read by activists, designers and students interested in culture jamming, media criticism and anti-capitalist politics.
